messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from safetensors streaming — canary hit a resume checksum mismatch, forced full rehydrate.
kevin: paste log?
maria: ci-bot:
``
ERROR shard-78 checksum mismatch at 1048576
header: {"fmt":"safetensors-stream-v1","seq":17}
expected sha256:aaa... actual sha256:aab...
```
oliver: writer did an index compact while client was resuming — our resume assumes immutability.
tara: decision: strict resume (fail on seq change) or permissive (find mergepoint)?
kevin: strict = simple but bandwidth heavy. permissive = complex and needs per-chunk validation.
june: propose small on-stream sequence id + footer pointer to compact merge manifest. client can fetch tail manifest and pick a safe offset.
maria: concrete minimal: header includes 8-byte sequence_id, footer contains manifest pointer+stream checksum, sidecar manifest lists sampled (seq,offset,chunk_hash). resume_token = seq:<id>:offset:<off>:hash:<h>.
oliver: keep manifest tail small so clients only need a couple of range reads (footer->manifest).
tara: warmup: resuming mid-shard may skip KV warmup; warmup needs to accept resumed starts or replay checkpoints.
june: API change: WeightsLoader.open(url, resume_token=None, permissive_resume=false). If permissive and token present, try manifest-based resume.
ci-bot: tests: weights-loader-resume failed in 3 cases.
maria: action items: RFC PR for header/footer/manifest (maria), manifest writer prototype (oliver), loader API + tests (june), warmup perf plan (tara), server-side concat sketch (kevin). Keep permissive_resume opt-in for now. :thumbsup:
